description: Derived Map of Global Electricity Transmission and Distribution lines: Mekong Region Countries is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Myanmar. Coverage: Myanmar. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Myanmar. Its tags are Electricity infrastructure, Electricity production, SDG12 Responsible Consumption and Production. It offers 1 resource(s) in geotiff. The portal shows 2021-07-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
